name: Personal Flight Systems: Jet Suits & Human-Carrying VTOL
summary: The engineering of jet suits, jetpacks and personal VTOL: thrust-to-weight, fuel fraction, stability with a human in the loop, and safety.

topics.name: History: rocket belts, jetpacks and jet suits
Fuel mass fraction and endurance limits
Micro gas turbines and electric ducted fans
Stability augmentation and fly-by-wire for individuals
Heat, noise and exhaust hazards to the pilot
Failure modes, redundancy and safe landing
Regulation and certification of personal aircraft
